decisions.reason: As a close extension of the firm's fabricated solutions for utilities and industrial applications, it likely meets a modest aspiration level or is given time because the firm has the capabilities and some slack to support it.

Because public waste bins are comparatively distant from the firm's established offer, any early underperformance would more readily trigger problemistic search and reallocation of resources back to better-fitting activities.
Ground sleeves are a simple adjacent metal product that fits the firm's production and public-sector customer base, so management is likely to keep it unless clear evidence of weak demand emerges.

Cast iron ground sleeves still relate to the firm's market and customer base, but the material and product specificity make them somewhat more uncertain, raising the chance of exit while still leaving retention slightly more likely.

Steel ground sleeves align well with the firm's steel-processing expertise and narrow existing range, so boundedly rational management would likely continue them absent obvious shortfalls versus aspirations.
